sentences.text:
The petitioner vide the present petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973 seeks quashing of FIR No.022/2019 dated 17.01.2029 registered under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC at P.S. Samaypur Badli, Outer North Delhi and all proceeding emanating therefrom in view of the Settlement Deed dated 19.08.2023 arrived at between the parties.

2. This petition is accompanied by the Settlement Deed dated 19.08.2023 [Annexure-P-2] and is also supported by affidavits of all the petitioners and of respondent no.2, alongwith proofs of their respective I.Ds.
3.
Petitioner and as also respondent no.2 are present in Court and have been identified by the IO.
Their credentials have been verified by this Court.
4. Issue Notice.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 11/11/2023 at 10:35:03 5.
Learned APP accepts notice.
He confirms that he has no objection to the quashing of the FIR.
6. Learned counsel for the respondent no.2 also accepts notice.
Respondent no.2 confirms that the petitioner and respondent no.2 have been granted divorce by mutual consent vide Decree of Divorce dated 16.09.2023.

She further affirms the Settlement Deed dated 19.08.2023 whereby the petitioner Sohan Lal vs The State & Anr on 10 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/199725400/
